current_checkpoint_note: Authenticated Real-Data Stabilisation Phase (starting SHA 833b0ed) -- a data-integrity/production-readiness pass, not a feature build, investigating the product owner's real report: 'sign in successfully, but many screens do not fully load the farm data' on mobile. Real Supabase CLI access to Farm Return V1 Dev (linked, read-only) confirmed the real authenticated Dev farm ('KC'): 1 farm, onboarding complete, 1 mapped field (0.62ha, real P/K Index), 1 livestock group (20 suckler cows, grazing), 0 housing/soil tests/slurry/job sessions/decisions/jobs. Full screen-by-screen real-vs-mock audit (docs/real-data/AUTHENTICATED_REAL_DATA_AUDIT.md) found every mock-farm-touching screen already correctly gated on isRealMode/useIsRealMode() or naturally inert against a real Postgres UUID, with one real exception found and fixed: Livestock economics and Feed Optimiser both fed a real farmer's real steer group's margin through a mock Bord Bia cattle-price constant unconditionally (Codex round 1, CRITICAL; a real heifer group could never actually reach this path -- finishingOptionsForGroup already fails closed for finishing_heifer, no evidenced budget exists, an inaccuracy in this note's own earlier wording that round 7 corrected) -- fixed with an honest 'Market data is currently unavailable' state for that path; a round-2 finding (MEDIUM) that the same fix's fallback animal-type default could misdiagnose a genuinely unsupported group was also fixed; round 7 (MEDIUM) fixed the unavailable-state branch's own reused, now-inaccurate PageHeader subtitle. Investigated the actual mobile symptom with real evidence, not a guess: loading this dev server via its own LAN IP reproduced real, confirmed 503 responses on `_next/static/chunks/*` for a route's first visit in this dev-server process's lifetime. The cause is not yet independently proven by a server-side trace -- Turbopack's on-demand compilation under real Wi-Fi latency (a dev-mode-only failure class; a real deployment/production build has no cold routes at all) is the best-supported explanation given everything observed, disclosed plainly as a hypothesis pending one further confirmation step, not asserted as settled fact (Codex audit round 3, MEDIUM, corrected an earlier version of this same sentence that blurred the two). Ruled out directly: Supabase cookie secure-flag, proxy.ts redirect behaviour, Mapbox token referrer restriction (tested with three different Referer headers against the real token), geolocation crash risk (already defensively guarded). A defensive allowedDevOrigins/DEV_LAN_IP config change was tried and then genuinely reverted (Codex audit round 6, MEDIUM) once empirically tested against real client-side navigation and found to make no difference for this exact direct-LAN-IP topology -- the phone's own request Origin already equals the dev server's own request host by construction, with no proxy/alternate-hostname involved for that check to ever actually gate. Full account, including the correction: docs/real-data/HOSTING_DIAGNOSIS.md. The prior 'native-mobile-background-gps-feasibility-2026-09-04' checkpoint this field held before is CLOSED (14-round Codex audit loop, 0/0/0/0 at round 14) and unchanged by this entry.
